summary: DarkIris Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule of $1.00 per share for continued listing. The company had been non-compliant since November 18, 2025, and was granted an initial 180-day cure period and then an additional 180-day extension through November 16, 2026. On May 27, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed that closing bid prices had been at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days ending May 26, 2026, closing the matter. This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation.
